remarks: Beautifully Renovated  &  Move-In Ready! Nestled in a quiet Pasadena neighborhood, this thoughtfully upgraded residence underwent an extensive renovation in 2019, featuring quality materials and attention to detail throughout. Beautiful North American solid oak hardwood flooring adds warmth and timeless elegance, while Milgard double-pane windows with maple wood window grilles provide enhanced insulation, noise reduction, and classic appeal. The entire drainage plumbing system was replaced as part of the renovation.
